g.text: B5 cross-field structure: mean phase survives, but high-band coherence and joint uncertainty do not
Panels C–D display the mean of the real and imaginary cross-spectrum projections for readability; PASS requires both separately frozen projection checks to pass. All 18 projection checks fail.
